## Convert Quote to Invoice

Mirrors `close-won.gts`'s pattern: re-fetch the subject before reading its links, save through `SaveCardCommand`, patch compound fields (line items) via `PatchCardInstanceCommand` rather than constructing them as field-class instances directly. Not itself one of the 18 tracked matrix concepts, but Spec'd anyway per this realm's convention of specing every reusable command (Sole Vault did the same for `process-payment-command.ts`).

### Non-goals
Does not itself calculate tax — delegates to `calculate-tax-command.ts` when a jurisdiction is supplied.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Quote/acme-enterprise-renewal-q1` (`status: 'won'`) — exactly the precondition this command requires. `Invoice/acme-enterprise-renewal-inv` shows the hand-authored result of running it (a real invoice with matching line items and tax breakdown).
attributes.cardDescription: Approves a Quote, stamps an Invoice Number, copies its line items onto a new Invoice, and calculates tax when a jurisdiction is supplied.
